一份完整、可带走的声音: Your complete recording, ready to export
与 Zoom / Webex 静音独立。仅选择设备不会采集；设备缺失时不会自动更: Independent of Zoom / Webex mute. Selecting a device does not start capture. A missing device is never replaced automatically. Headphones are recommended.
专注当下，完整记录: Stay present. Keep the full conversation.
专用实例使用独立 user-data-dir。启动 PID 只是候选，仍需刷新并: The dedicated browser uses a separate user-data-dir. Its launch PID is only a candidate: refresh and select the actual audio session. Run a 10-second test when using a source for the first time or after it changes.
从头播放完整录音: Play the full recording from the start
从独立原轨生成真正的混音，再按接收服务的大小要求导出。: Create a true mix from the separate source tracks, then export files that meet your upload service's size limits.
会议进程树 · 选定应用及其子进程: Process tree · Selected app and its child processes
保存状态：尚未创建本次录音: Storage: this recording has not been created
先在会议库选择一场已保存录音。: Select a saved recording in the meeting library first.
先选择会议；尚无字幕也能播放完整录音。: Select a meeting first. You can play the full recording without subtitles.
单击带时间的字幕可立即回听；纯文字可选择校订。: Click a timed subtitle to play it. Select untimed text to edit it.
单击带时间的字幕，立即跳到对应录音并播放；再次单击可从该句重新听。键盘选中后按: Click a timed subtitle to jump to it and play. Click again to replay the sentence, or select it with the keyboard and press Enter.
原轨、浏览器资料和导出分别存放于此目录内。最长单场录音为 8 小时。: Source tracks, browser data and exports are stored separately within this folder. Each recording can last up to 8 hours.
另附分段时间映射清单（文件名、哈希与时间）: Include a part timeline manifest (filenames, hashes and times)
只导出所选混音副本。不附原始麦克风轨、浏览器资料或诊断日志；上传由你自行操作。: Exports contain only the selected mix copies. Original microphone tracks, browser data and diagnostic logs are excluded. You upload the files yourself.
完整时间轴保留暂停与缺口；导出任务独立运行，不阻挡下一场录音。: The full timeline preserves pauses and gaps. Export runs independently so you can start your next recording.
导入 WAV / MP3 / M4A，复制并保留原件: Import WAV / MP3 / M4A and preserve a copy of the original
导入的是导出分片：设置时间映射: Importing an exported part: set its timeline mapping
导出当前回听版本的完整字幕（SRT / VTT）: Export all subtitles from the selected playback version (SRT / VTT)
将外部转写结果带回这场会议: Add an external transcript to this meeting
尚未读取任何历史录音。: No saved recording has been loaded.
尚未读取转写。所有内容仅在本地处理。: No transcript loaded. All processing stays on this computer.
尚未采集。请选择本次音频来源，预检后主动开始录音。: Not capturing. Select the audio source, run preflight, then start recording.
左侧按日期选择历史会议；原始录音始终独立保存。: Choose a saved meeting by date on the left. Original recordings remain stored separately.
当前音频来源及麦克风状态: Current audio source and microphone status
录音保存后会自动生成完整混音。也可以在会议库选择历史录音后重试。: A full mix is generated after the recording is saved. You can also select a saved meeting in the library and retry.
录音期间（包括暂停与保存收尾）禁用回放。字幕时间为近似值，可单击或按 Enter: Playback is disabled during recording, including pauses and final saving. Subtitle times are approximate. Click or press Enter to seek.
恢复创建新副本，不覆盖原件。只包含可验证的数据，不代表缺失的录音已经找回。: Recovery creates a new copy without overwriting originals. It includes only verified data and does not mean missing audio has been recovered.
我已核对该程序和模型来源可信，并确认模型许可允许本次本地使用。: I have verified that the program and model are from trusted sources and that the model license permits this local use.
我确认：会录入此设备上其他应用和通知声音: I understand: other apps and notifications on this device will also be recorded
打开专用 Chrome 合成音页: Open synthetic audio in dedicated Chrome
搜索当前数据目录的所有会议（点击搜索时读取）: Search all meetings in the current data folder (loaded when you search)
播放时在这里显示当前字幕: The current subtitle appears here during playback
支持 TXT、Markdown、SRT、VTT 和 ProjectEcho JS: Supports TXT, Markdown, SRT, VTT and ProjectEcho JSON. Plain text remains untimed. The original and each revision are saved separately.
未使用分片映射：字幕按完整会议时间导入。: No part mapping: subtitle times refer to the full meeting timeline.
本场明确开启麦克风 · 默认关闭: Enable microphone for this meeting · Off by default
来源名称（例如手动转写或服务名称）: Source name (e.g. manual transcript or service name)
查看预检结果与环境信息，选择本地保存位置。: Review preflight and environment details, and choose a local storage folder.
模型 SHA-256（可选，用于与可信来源公布的值比对）: Model SHA-256 (optional; compare with a trusted published hash)
浏览器范围包含选定进程树的所有有声标签页，不能据此保证单标签隔离。: Browser capture includes every audible tab in the selected process tree. It does not guarantee isolation of a single tab.
点击会议库读取历史: Open the meeting library to load saved meetings
点击左侧会议库读取列表。也可以导入已有录音，或开始一场新会议。: Open the meeting library on the left to load saved meetings, import audio, or start a new recording.
留住讨论，接续思考: Keep the conversation. Continue the thinking.
留空时按当前日期时间命名: Leave blank to use the current date and time
确认会议声音来自哪里，再决定是否录下自己的麦克风。: Confirm the meeting's audio source, then choose whether to record your microphone.
端点兼容 · 输出设备上的所有应用声音: Output device · All app audio on the selected device
识别使用完整混音的会后副本；每次尝试单独保存输出和耗时。识别结果需校对，尚无本机: Transcription uses a copy of the full mix after recording. Each attempt saves its output and elapsed time separately. Review the results; accuracy and speed have not been established on this computer.
输入关键词；搜索只在本地进行: Enter keywords; search stays on this computer
进入录音界面查看控制: Open the recording page for controls
选择自己准备好的 CLI 和模型。无需账号或 API；未配置时仍可正常录音、导出: Choose your own CLI and model. No account or API is needed. Recording, export and text import still work without them.
选择该场已生成混音对应的 export-manifest.json 或本地导出记: Choose the export-manifest.json or local export receipt for this meeting's mix, then enter the part filename. Subtitle times start at 0 for that part. The source mix is verified during import.
部分平台、双设备长期同步及干净 Windows 验收尚未完成。首次使用或更换来源: Some platforms, long-term synchronization between devices, and clean Windows validation remain unverified. Make a controlled test recording before first use or after changing sources.
重叠内容只提示复核，保留各片原文。人物标签不等于已确认身份。录音和暂停期间不可回: Overlapping text is flagged for review; each part's original text is preserved. Speaker labels do not confirm identity. Playback is unavailable while recording or paused.
默认预算为 20 MB / 30 分钟，重叠 5 秒；请按接收服务要求调整。: Defaults: 20 MB / 30 minutes per part, with a 5-second overlap. Adjust to your upload service's requirements.
